create_Scheduler: create a Scheduler wrapping a PyTorch optimizer with a named lr_scheduler and initial learning rate
create_ConstantSchedule: create a ConstantSchedule that returns a fixed numeric value when called
run_to_scheduler: run to_scheduler to initialize a Scheduler or ConstantSchedule from a config spec
run_set_scheduler_repo: run set_scheduler_repo to register a dictionary of scheduler specs by name
review_Scheduler_step: review the Scheduler step method that advances the lr_scheduler and dummy optimizer
